newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares gain slightly in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares gain slightly in light trade.

text.p: Lithuanian shares gained slightly in light trade on Wednesday as investors slowly returned to the market, dealers said.
Baltic Ship Yard was the most active share, rising almost ten percent to 9.07 litas in trade of over 310,000 litas.
Dealers said the company's price was buoyed by a a huge block deal on Tuesday in its shares involving a foreign investor.
Rokishkis Cheese was also comparatively active, turning over 191,000 litas, and its share price advanced to 47.50 litas from 47.00 litas.
Losers included Hermis Bank, which saw its price slide to 189.90 litas from 195.00 litas in trade worth 104,500 litas.
Vilniaus Bank also eased, slipping to 240.00 litas from 250.00 litas in trade of 12,000 litas.
"Investors are coming back now and sorting out their portfolios," said Kesteutis Kvanauskas of Vilniaus Bank's brokerage department.
"We see a lot of potential for growth as Lithuanian shares are quite cheap compared with other Eastern European equities," he added.
